configurePresets.name: clang
configurePresets.description: Default toolchain: clang-cl/lld-link from the standalone LLVM package at C:/Program Files/LLVM. CPU parts only.

configurePresets.name: msvc
configurePresets.description: cl.exe/link.exe; also builds the GPU variant through the CUDA Visual Studio integration if the toolkit is installed.

configurePresets.name: cuda
configurePresets.displayName: Ninja (clang-cl + nvcc), CPU and GPU parts
configurePresets.description: clang-cl for the C++ sources, nvcc with cl.exe as host compiler for the CUDA sources. Needs the MSVC environment (build.bat sets it up) and CUDA 13 or newer.

configurePresets.name: linux
configurePresets.displayName: Ninja (GCC or Clang), CPU parts only
configurePresets.description: The system's C++ compiler (CXX picks another); no GPU variant.

configurePresets.name: linux-cuda
configurePresets.displayName: Ninja (GCC + nvcc), CPU and GPU parts
configurePresets.description: The system's C++ compiler, and nvcc from the PATH or CUDACXX (CUDA 13 or newer) with GCC as host compiler.
